settings.title: Care & sizing
settings.content:
Getting the size right: measure your pet nose to base of tail while they're stretched out asleep, then add 15–20cm. Curlers can size down; sprawlers should size up.

Keeping it fresh: follow the care label on the bed. Where a bed has a removable cover, wash the cover and never the foam or fibre inside. Air it outside on a dry day to keep it smelling fresh between washes.

Questions? Email [support_email] — we're around [support_hours].

settings.question: How do I know which size to choose?
settings.answer: Measure your pet from nose to base of tail while they're stretched out asleep, then add 15–20cm. Tap Size guide above the size buttons for a breed-by-breed table, or take the Sleep Match for a recommendation in 60 seconds.
